text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for CascadeHealth (dedicated cluster). Severity: P1. Rule: reserved-pool-latency > 95th 2s for 5m. Link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-CR12345

pagerduty: Page delivered to eng-oncall escalation policy (primary: maria).

maria: acked. I'm taking initial triage. seeing spike in p95 from ~400ms -> ~2.4s. Errors up too (500s).

eli: oncall wake. i'll join. can you paste the pool id and recent scaling events?

maria: pool=cascade-prod-reserved-3, region=us-west-2. autoscaler logs show recent OOM evictions on node gpu-17 ~ 10:12. no new capacity added since last commit.

ops-alex: paging from infra: maintenance job (kernel upgrade) completed on 3 hosts at 09:50, but one host failed kube-proxy restart around 10:05 and kubelet flapped. could correlate.

maria: metric snippets:
```
requests_total: 124k last 10m
p95_latency: 2.42s (baseline 0.39s)
5xx_rate: 2.3% (baseline 0.1%)
queue_length: reserved-queue=128 -> saturated
```

eli: ok immediate mitigation options: 1) force-burst-add nodes to reserved pool 2) reroute heavy tenants to fallback shared pool 3) enable token-throttling for CascadeHealth to protect cluster. prefer 2+3 while infra recovers.

maria: tried autoscaler manual scale +2 but pods stuck in ContainerCreating with attach errors: "failed to attach volume: timeout". suspect underlying node flaps.

incident-bot: Note: manual scale attempted at 10:18 by maria — result: partial.

sre_jess: i'll start failover plan. Maria, can you open the tenant fallback route? i'll coordinate PD escalations and customer comms.

maria: triggering route to fallback-model-usw now: `redwood route set --tenant CascadeHealth --gateway fallback-model-usw --force`

ops-alex: infra confirms 2 hosts in us-west-2 are reporting NVLINK faults, kernel logs attached (short dump):
```
[ 10.05.23 ] nvidia: GPU reset due to timeout on gpu-17
[ 10.06.11 ] kubelet: failed to mount pvc /dev/nvme1n1: i/o error
```

eli: thanks. reroute seems to be accepting traffic but at reduced throughput. need to watch for throttles. set a short TTL on cascade fallback so we can revert.

maria: cascade fallback route applied at 10:26. requests draining, p95 dropped to ~780ms but 5xx still 0.9% (in-flight errors from earlier).

sre_jess: initiating temporary customer impact note for SRE->CS at 10:28. Draft: "CascadeHealth experienced elevated inference latency and increased error rates from 10:12-10:30 UTC due to node-level GPU faults. We routed traffic to a fallback pool to restore service; residual errors remain while in-flight requests drain. Working on infra remediation and will update at 11:00 UTC."

eli: good. also enable aggressive KV cache warmup on fallback to reduce token compute: `redwood admin kvcache --tenant CascadeHealth --warmup --parallel=20`

ops-alex: running, ETA ~90s.

maria: PD shows one acknowledgement from maria at 10:15, no further escalation. oncall-rotations-bot: next rotation in 28m.

incident-bot: If no ack from next oncall in 5m, automatic escalate to sre_jess.

eli: i can stay until root cause identified. planning to coordinate with infra for node cordon + reprovision of affected hosts.

ops-alex: cordoned gpu-17 and gpu-18 at 10:33. starting reprovision.

maria: traffic now stable on fallback: p95=420ms, 5xx=0.2%. queue length normalizing.

sre_jess: taking over the bridge at 10:36 for handoff from maria. maria, pls add any open action items to the incident thread.

maria: handing off: 1) infra reprovision hosts (in progress). 2) follow-up: investigate why kube-proxy restart failed after kernel upgrade. 3) customer comms (CS) to confirm impact window and any SLO implications.

sre_jess: noted. i'll coordinate with infra and CS. set incident state=investigating. target update cadence 30m.

oncall-rotations-bot: Reminder: next rotation user=eli at 11:02 UTC.

eli: copy. i'll be available for deep-dive if needed. good job getting fallback in place. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident PD-CR12345 updated: acknowledged by maria; assigned to sre_jess for follow-up.

sre_jess: closing short-term mitigation. leaving fallback route in place until infra confirms reprovision + green kube status. will reopen if regressions.

maria: closing local triage. will attach logs and timeline to the incident doc.

ops-alex: reprovision completed at 10:58. nodes passed health checks. uncordoning now.

sre_jess: beginning controlled rejoin of cluster and slow traffic migration back. will monitor error rate for 15m.

maria: final check at 11:04: p95=410ms on primary pool, 5xx back to baseline 0.12%. queue normal.

sre_jess: rollback fallback route at 11:06 and declare mitigated. Postmortem planned; tagging infra and runtime teams.

incident-bot: Incident PD-CR12345: mitigated at 11:06. Follow-up owner: ops-alex.

maria: thanks everyone — will open postmortem and link to PD.

eli: thanks. short, sharp, handled well.
